title: Going from market intelligence to market imagination may hold the key to FMCG growth in India
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) brings FMCG to a similar inflection point. While improving forecasts and automating tasks are worthwhile applications, the bigger opportunity lies in asking what we can solve today that was previously too complex or expensive to tackle at scale, whether it is understanding consumers more deeply, reaching underserved markets, or detecting fake packs from field photos before they damage brand trust.
